replykit.audience: freelancers who send proposals and client replies
replykit.coreJob: reuse proposal macros with shortcuts and one-click insert
bullets: Save reusable proposal and follow-up snippets
Insert into the focused field or expand shortcuts like ;intro
Start from an Upwork-oriented starter pack
replykit.activeTabUse: insert the selected snippet into the focused field
replykit.scriptingUse: insert or expand text the user selected
replykit.hostJustification: Optional broad access so shortcut expansion works in text fields on sites the user already works in. Activated by the user’s typing/settings.
replykit.testStep1: Open a page with a text box, focus it, open ReplyKit, click a starter snippet.
replykit.testStep2: Type ;intro then Space and confirm expansion.

storepulse.coreJob: run a quick storefront/admin health scan and copy a client report
bullets: Scan the active Shopify-related tab
Check images, pixels, policy links, and publish cues
Copy a markdown client report
storepulse.activeTabUse: scan the page the user is viewing
storepulse.scriptingUse: collect on-page health signals after the user clicks Scan
storepulse.hostJustification: Limited to Shopify admin/storefront hosts named in the listing so scans run where agencies already work.
storepulse.testStep1: Open a Shopify storefront or admin page and click Scan.
storepulse.testStep2: Copy the client report and confirm checklist rows appear.

clientmark.coreJob: label Meta/Google Ads client accounts across tabs
bullets: Save client labels matched by URL substring
Show a badge and optional tab title prefix
Draw a color bar on matching ads pages
clientmark.activeTabUse: prefill URL match from the current ads tab
clientmark.scriptingUse: update tab title / UI marker on matching ads pages
clientmark.tabsUse: Apply badge text/color on relevant tabs
clientmark.hostJustification: Restricted to Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager hosts.
clientmark.testStep1: Save a mark with a URL fragment from an ads page.
clientmark.testStep2: Reload the page and confirm badge/bar/label behavior.

bidmatch.audience: freelancers, grant writers, and BD folks
bidmatch.coreJob: highlight saved keywords on RFP and job pages
bullets: Create colored keyword sets
Highlight matches on the current page
Toggle sets and re-run highlighting
bidmatch.activeTabUse: re-highlight the page after the user clicks
bidmatch.scriptingUse: wrap matching keywords in mark elements on the page
bidmatch.hostJustification: Works on arbitrary job/RFP sites the user visits; highlighting only uses keyword sets the user configured.
bidmatch.testStep1: Open a page containing a starter keyword (e.g. typescript).
bidmatch.testStep2: Open BidMatch and click Re-highlight; confirm highlights.

promptledger.coreJob: capture prompts/outputs into a client-tagged audit trail
bullets: Save prompts, outputs, and notes
Capture from selection or context menu
Export markdown for a client
promptledger.activeTabUse: capture selected text and source URL/title
promptledger.scriptingUse: read the user’s selection when they click From selection
promptledger.contextMenusUse: Save selected text as prompt/output/note via right-click
promptledger.hostJustification: Selection capture works on AI tool pages and docs the user chooses.
promptledger.testStep1: Select text on a page → right-click → save as prompt.
promptledger.testStep2: Export markdown and confirm the entry appears.

bullets: Capture the visible tab with one click
Apply accessibility/privacy/launch checklists
Export an evidence markdown pack
evidencekit.activeTabUse: capture the visible tab the user is reviewing
evidencekit.scriptingUse: N/A if unused — otherwise support page context
evidencekit.hostJustification: User can capture evidence on the page they are auditing after an explicit click.
evidencekit.testStep1: Open any page, choose a template, click Capture.
evidencekit.testStep2: Tick checklist items and copy the evidence pack.

paybump.coreJob: insert failed-payment and invoice follow-up macros
bullets: Starter Stripe/invoice macros
One-click insert into the focused field
Shortcut expansion like ;card
paybump.activeTabUse: insert the selected macro into the focused field
paybump.scriptingUse: insert/expand macro text the user chose
paybump.hostJustification: Macros can be inserted into email/support/billing tools the user already uses.
paybump.testStep1: Focus a text box, open PayBump, click Friendly card update.
paybump.testStep2: Type ;card then Space and confirm expansion.

shopswitch.audience: Shopify agencies managing many client shops
shopswitch.coreJob: save, label, and jump between Shopify admin stores
bullets: Save admin.shopify.com / myshopify admin URLs
Color-label client stores
Open a store admin in one click
shopswitch.activeTabUse: detect current Shopify admin URL to save quickly
shopswitch.scriptingUse: show a color bar on matching Shopify admin pages
shopswitch.tabsUse: open the selected store admin tab
shopswitch.hostJustification: Limited to Shopify admin hosts so agencies can switch client shops they already access.
shopswitch.testStep1: Save a store with an admin.shopify.com/store/... URL.
shopswitch.testStep2: Click the store to open it; confirm it appears in the list.

citebrowse.coreJob: capture bibliographic metadata and export BibTeX
bullets: Capture citation fields from publisher pages
Build cite keys automatically
Copy one entry or export the library as BibTeX
citebrowse.activeTabUse: read citation metadata from the current article page
citebrowse.scriptingUse: extract meta tags / DOI-like fields on user capture
citebrowse.hostJustification: Researchers capture citations while browsing arbitrary publisher pages.
citebrowse.testStep1: Open a publisher page with citation meta tags and click Capture.

formpack.audience: operators filling shipping, grant, or admin forms
formpack.coreJob: autofill forms from niche field packs
bullets: Starter shipping/grant/admin profiles
Map by field name/label hints
Fill the current page in one click
formpack.activeTabUse: fill fields on the form the user is viewing
formpack.scriptingUse: write values into matching inputs after the user clicks a profile
formpack.hostJustification: Autofill must work on the variety of forms users already submit; only runs when the user clicks Fill.
formpack.testStep1: Open a form page with name/email fields.
formpack.testStep2: Click a FormPack profile and confirm fields populate.
